title: 阿姆倫鋁土礦
summary: 以韋帕南部鋁土礦及港口物流為例，研究礦、處理、堆場與出貨鏈。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
summaryEn: A southern-Weipa bauxite and port-logistics case examines the mine, treatment, stockpile and shipping chain. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 採區到裝運介面的連續物料流；船期變化與可用堆場涵蓋；產品含水率對乾基供應量的影響
v31FocusEn: Continuous material flow toward the shipment interface; Ship-schedule variation and accessible stock cover; Product-moisture effects on dry-basis supply

stages.title: 資源條件與系統邊界：阿姆倫鋁土礦
stages.titleEn: Resource conditions and system boundaries: Amrun bauxite mine
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「採區到裝運介面的連續物料流」與「船期變化與可用堆場涵蓋」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Continuous material flow toward the shipment interface" and "Ship-schedule variation and accessible stock cover": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「採區到裝運介面的連續物料流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Continuous material flow toward the shipment interface" is correct?
options: 輸送帶容量由堆積密度、料流截面與帶速決定；截面取決於槽形與裝載，不等於帶寬乘料高的任意矩形。
輸送帶速度正常就表示輸送噸數正常。
堆場總噸數足夠就不會出現缺料。
optionsEn: Belt capacity follows bulk density, loaded cross-section and belt speed.
Normal belt speed guarantees normal transported tonnage.
Enough total stockpile tonnes guarantee uninterrupted feed.
quiz.explanation: 輸送帶容量由堆積密度、料流截面與帶速決定；截面取決於槽形與裝載，不等於帶寬乘料高的任意矩形。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Belt capacity follows bulk density, loaded cross-section and belt speed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 採區到裝運介面的連續物料流：機制與資源流程
steps.titleEn: Continuous material flow toward the shipment interface: mechanism and resource flow
steps.objective: 說明「採區到裝運介面的連續物料流」如何決定「阿姆倫鋁土礦」的物料、能量、量測或環境功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Continuous material flow toward the shipment interface” governs material, energy, measurement or environmental functions in “Amrun bauxite mine”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 以「阿姆倫鋁土礦」作案例背景，本單元的原創桌上問題是「採區到裝運介面的連續物料流」。輸送帶容量由堆積密度、料流截面與帶速決定；截面取決於槽形與裝載，不等於帶寬乘料高的任意矩形。連續運搬仍受轉運點、落料分布與停機連鎖限制，平均容量不能證明整條系統無瓶頸。 這是情境分析，不宣稱該工程使用下列合成數值。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Using Amrun bauxite mine as the case setting, this original desk-based investigation addresses continuous material flow toward the shipment interface. Belt capacity follows bulk density, loaded cross-section and belt speed. Cross-section depends on trough geometry and loading, not an arbitrary width-height rectangle. Transfer points, feed distribution and linked downtime still constrain continuous transport, so average capacity does not prove an unconstrained system. This is scenario analysis and does not claim that the project uses the synthetic values below. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：以韋帕南部鋁土礦及港口物流為例，研究礦、處理、堆場與出貨鏈。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。

Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. steps.failure: 常見誤解：「輸送帶速度正常就表示輸送噸數正常。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal belt speed guarantees normal transported tonnage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「採區到裝運介面的連續物料流」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

quiz.question: 依「採區到裝運介面的連續物料流」的模型 Q = 3600·ρb·A·v，輸送帶連續運搬的合成教學算例；輸入單位：rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s。不是該場址實測或操作值。最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model Q = 3600·ρb·A·v for "Continuous material flow toward the shipment interface", which value is closest to the synthetic teaching example for continuous belt transport; input units: rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s. These are not measured or operating values for this site.?
quiz.explanation: Q = 3600·ρb·A·v；代入 rho = 1.8 t/m³ bulk、A = 0.22 m²、v = 3.2 m/s，得 4,562 t/h（輸送帶連續運搬的合成教學算例；輸入單位：rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: Q = 3600·ρb·A·v; with rho = 1.8 t/m³ bulk, A = 0.22 m², v = 3.2 m/s the result is 4,562 t/h (synthetic teaching example for continuous belt transport; input units: rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s. These are not measured or operating values for this site.). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 採區到裝運介面的連續物料流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Continuous material flow toward the shipment interface: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「採區到裝運介面的連續物料流」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Continuous material flow toward the shipment interface” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Q = 3600·ρb·A·v；代入 rho = 1.8 t/m³ bulk、A = 0.22 m²、v = 3.2 m/s，得 4,562 t/h（輸送帶連續運搬的合成教學算例；輸入單位：rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 v 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Q = 3600·ρb·A·v; with rho = 1.8 t/m³ bulk, A = 0.22 m², v = 3.2 m/s the result is 4,562 t/h (synthetic teaching example for continuous belt transport; input units: rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s. These are not measured or operating values for this site.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise v by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：v 增加 10% 時，結果變為 5,018 t/h（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising v by 10% changes the result to 5,018 t/h (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 4,562 t/h（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 v 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 4,562 t/h (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in v with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Q = 3600·ρb·A·v；代入 rho = 1.8 t/m³ bulk、A = 0.22 m²、v = 3.2 m/s，得 4,562 t/h（輸送帶連續運搬的合成教學算例；輸入單位：rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s。不是該場址實測或操作值。）。
knowledge.textEn: Q = 3600·ρb·A·v; with rho = 1.8 t/m³ bulk, A = 0.22 m², v = 3.2 m/s the result is 4,562 t/h (synthetic teaching example for continuous belt transport; input units: rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s. These are not measured or operating values for this site.).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: v 增加 10% 時，結果變為 5,018 t/h（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising v by 10% changes the result to 5,018 t/h (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為明示的合成教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are explicit synthetic teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

v31Model.meaningEn: Synthetic teaching example for continuous belt transport; input units: rho: t/m³ bulk; A: m²; v: m/s. These are not measured or operating values for this site.

quiz.question: 要驗證「採區到裝運介面的連續物料流」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Continuous material flow toward the shipment interface"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
物料帳有差額就能立即斷定有實體洩漏。
針對「採區到裝運介面的連續物料流」，使用合成的帶秤質量、帶速與料流截面重算，核對堆積密度的乾濕基；再以相同時間窗比較上下游流量。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.

For continuous material flow toward the shipment interface, recalculate synthetic belt-scale mass, speed and cross-section, checking wet/dry density basis and comparing upstream and downstream flows over identical time windows.
quiz.explanation: 針對「採區到裝運介面的連續物料流」，使用合成的帶秤質量、帶速與料流截面重算，核對堆積密度的乾濕基；再以相同時間窗比較上下游流量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: For continuous material flow toward the shipment interface, recalculate synthetic belt-scale mass, speed and cross-section, checking wet/dry density basis and comparing upstream and downstream flows over identical time windows. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 採區到裝運介面的連續物料流：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Continuous material flow toward the shipment interface: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「採區到裝運介面的連續物料流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Continuous material flow toward the shipment interface” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對「採區到裝運介面的連續物料流」，使用合成的帶秤質量、帶速與料流截面重算，核對堆積密度的乾濕基；再以相同時間窗比較上下游流量。 提交控制體圖與有單位的資料表，讓另一位學徒能獨立重算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For continuous material flow toward the shipment interface, recalculate synthetic belt-scale mass, speed and cross-section, checking wet/dry density basis and comparing upstream and downstream flows over identical time windows. Submit a control-volume diagram and a table with units so another learner can recalculate independently. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用圖示列出每個轉運點的暫存量與容量；不讓學生靠近運轉輸送機做量測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Diagram inventory and capacity at each transfer point; learners use datasets rather than approaching operating conveyors.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在「採區到裝運介面的連續物料流」情境，帶速正常但噸數下降，可能是空隙增加或落料不足；若上游滿載而下游偏低，則檢查轉運點累積與量測偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: In the scenario of continuous material flow toward the shipment interface, normal speed with lower tonnage may mean more voids or insufficient feed; full upstream loading with low downstream flow suggests transfer accumulation or measurement bias. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 針對「採區到裝運介面的連續物料流」，使用合成的帶秤質量、帶速與料流截面重算，核對堆積密度的乾濕基；再以相同時間窗比較上下游流量。 提交控制體圖與有單位的資料表，讓另一位學徒能獨立重算。
knowledge.textEn: For continuous material flow toward the shipment interface, recalculate synthetic belt-scale mass, speed and cross-section, checking wet/dry density basis and comparing upstream and downstream flows over identical time windows. Submit a control-volume diagram and a table with units so another learner can recalculate independently.

quiz.question: 在「採區到裝運介面的連續物料流」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Continuous material flow toward the shipment interface" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 在「採區到裝運介面的連續物料流」情境，帶速正常但噸數下降，可能是空隙增加或落料不足；若上游滿載而下游偏低，則檢查轉運點累積與量測偏差。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
堆場總噸數足夠就不會出現缺料。
optionsEn: In the scenario of continuous material flow toward the shipment interface, normal speed with lower tonnage may mean more voids or insufficient feed.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Enough total stockpile tonnes guarantee uninterrupted feed.
quiz.explanation: 在「採區到裝運介面的連續物料流」情境，帶速正常但噸數下降，可能是空隙增加或落料不足；若上游滿載而下游偏低，則檢查轉運點累積與量測偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: In the scenario of continuous material flow toward the shipment interface, normal speed with lower tonnage may mean more voids or insufficient feed; full upstream loading with low downstream flow suggests transfer accumulation or measurement bias. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 採區到裝運介面的連續物料流：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Continuous material flow toward the shipment interface: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「採區到裝運介面的連續物料流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 在「船期變化與可用堆場涵蓋」情境，總庫存充足卻斷料，可能是可回收範圍不足或合格品位堆場已空；需要依區域與品質追蹤。 記錄哪一項獨立資料能排除替代原因。
knowledge.textEn: In the scenario of ship-schedule variation and accessible stock cover, a stoppage despite ample total stock may reflect limited reclaim access or exhausted on-spec stock; track inventory by location and quality. Record which independent observation rules out an alternative cause.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 證據版本
knowledge.text: 2026-11-10：核對官方工程識別與公開情境；算例由作者設定為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: 2026-11-10: Primary project identity and public context reviewed; numerical examples are authored teaching assumptions.
